CONFIDENCE: 0.7
EXPLANATION: Strong halogen-related band at 525 cm⁻¹ is consistent with P–Cl stretching in phosphorochloridates; the 716 cm⁻¹ band matches typical C–Cl stretching of a CHCl group; the 1071 cm⁻¹ band fits a P–O–C stretch in phosphate esters; and the CH stretches at 2946 and 3014 cm⁻¹ plus the 1450 cm⁻¹ CH bending are consistent with an ethyl substituent (GFQ-003 for CH stretches/bends). This pattern best matches CC(Cl)OP(Cl)Cl.
